proposal.summary: Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25 allow XXE attacks that lead to information disclosure; fixed in firmware LW80.*.P246 (or later).

proposal.recommended_next_step: Update affected Lexmark devices to firmware version LW80.*.P246 (or later) as provided by the vendor, and review XML processing configurations to disable external entity resolution where possible.
